summary.zh: 面向面包、蛋糕、西点、饼干与门店装饰的巧克力选型：夹心、淋面、耐烤、包衣与装饰在同一条产线上往往需要不同的巧克力体系。
summary.en: Chocolate selection for bread, cakes, pastry, cookies and in-store decoration: filling, glazing, bake-stable inclusions, enrobing and decoration often need different chocolate systems on one line.

zh: 耐烤夹入（曲奇、面包、玛芬）
调温与环境温度决定纯脂巧克力的光泽与脆度，代脂体系则以操作便利为主。
耐烤应用要同时考虑烘焙温度、时间、面团含水量与糖油体系，而非单一耐温数字。
淋面关注表面流平与凝固光泽，夹心关注切面稳定与储存迁移。
en: Tempering and ambient temperature drive gloss and snap in couverture; compound systems prioritise handling convenience.
Bake-stable use depends on bake temperature, time, dough moisture and fat–sugar system together, not one heat number.
Glazing prioritises levelling and set gloss; fillings prioritise cut stability and storage migration.

zh: 耐烤豆变形或塌陷——多与烘焙温度、时间及颗粒尺寸不匹配有关。
淋面不平或起雾——常见于调温、环境湿度或涂层厚度问题。
夹心迁移或渗油——与配方水分、脂肪体系及储存温度相关。
en: Bake-stable chips deforming or slumping — usually a mismatch of bake temperature, time and chip size.
Uneven or bloomed glaze — often tempering, ambient humidity or coating thickness.
Filling migration or oiling-out — related to formula moisture, fat system and storage temperature.

zh: 最终产品类型与配方目标
设备（调温机、淋面线、包衣机等）
目标口融、脆度与货架期
en: Finished product type and formula goal
Target melt, snap and shelf life

summary.zh: 脆皮、涂层、内馅与冷冻稳定：低温环境对巧克力的脆裂、附着与抗裂提出特定要求。
summary.en: Shells, coating, inclusions and frozen stability: low-temperature use places specific demands on snap, adhesion and crack resistance.

alt.zh: 冰淇淋巧克力涂层应用

zh: 涂层需要在低温下快速凝固并保持脆度，涂层黏度与温度需匹配浸涂或喷涂设备。
冷冻甜品对抗裂与附着要求高，脂肪体系与巧克力用量共同影响表现。
淋酱在低温下的流动性与固化速度需要单独评估。
en: Coatings must set quickly at low temperature while keeping snap; viscosity and temperature must match dip or spray equipment.
Frozen desserts demand crack resistance and adhesion; fat system and chocolate load both matter.
Sauce flow and set speed at low temperature need separate evaluation.

zh: 涂层开裂或脱落——与抗裂配方、涂层厚度及温差有关。
脆壳过厚或不脆——涂层黏度与温度未匹配。
en: Coating cracking or flaking — related to crack-resistant formula, coating thickness and temperature gradient.
Shell too thick or not crisp — viscosity and temperature mismatch.

zh: 最终产品（脆皮、脆壳、内馅等）

summary.zh: 风味酱、调饮、酸乳与创意融合：巧克力在饮品与乳品中的分散性、稳定性与风味释放是关键。
summary.en: Flavour sauces, drinks, yoghurt and fusion concepts: dispersion, stability and flavour release are the key variables in beverage and dairy use.

alt.zh: 巧克力饮品与乳品应用

zh: 现制茶饮与咖啡风味酱
en: Freshly-made tea and coffee flavour sauces

zh: 现制饮品关注酱体在冷/热条件下的分散与不结块。
厚乳与调饮需要稳定的甜度与可可强度，便于门店标准化出杯。
与本土风味（茶、坚果、果味）的搭配可形成差异化产品。
en: Freshly-made drinks focus on sauce dispersion and no clumping in cold or hot conditions.
Thick-milk and drink bases need stable sweetness and cocoa intensity for consistent store output.
Pairing with local flavours (tea, nuts, fruit) supports differentiated products.

zh: 酱体分散不均或沉底——与溶解条件和搅拌方式有关。
冷饮结块——温度与配方需匹配。
en: Uneven dispersion or settling — related to dissolving conditions and mixing.
Cold-drink clumping — temperature and formula must match.

summary.zh: 批次稳定、设备适配与量产支持：工业客户更关注一致性、供货能力与合规文件。
summary.en: Batch consistency, equipment fit and scale-up: industrial customers prioritise consistency, supply capability and compliance documentation.

zh: 涂层与内馅（雪糕、饼干、糖果）
en: Coatings and fillings (ice cream, biscuits, confectionery)

zh: 工业产线对批次一致性与流变稳定性要求高，需匹配泵送、管径与剪切条件。
从原料入厂到成品出厂建立全链路品控（109 道管控、2 个 CCP、19 步过滤）。
量产前通常需要小试—中试—量产的验证路径与第三方检测文件。
en: Industrial lines demand batch consistency and rheological stability, matched to pumps, pipe diameter and shear.
End-to-end quality control from incoming material to finished goods (109 controls, 2 CCPs, 19 filtration steps).
Scale-up usually needs a lab–pilot–production validation path and third-party test documentation.

zh: 批次间波动——需要标准化品控与稳定供应链支撑。
产线适配问题——黏度、剪切与设备参数未对齐。
en: Batch-to-batch variation — needs standardised QC and a stable supply chain.
Line-fit issues — viscosity, shear and equipment parameters not aligned.
Equipment parameters (pumps, pipe diameter, temperature zones)
